P02.judgment:
Response 1: Deep navy base, warm off-white text, teal/amber accent; minimal purposeful animations — reduces eye strain, avoids chaos, respects accessibility.

Response 2: Deep navy/near-black base, teal-green/amber accents, warm off-white text; subtle fade-ins/gentle parallax — reduces strain, improves accessibility, communicates effectively.

UNIFYING TEXTURE: Honest, restrained, principle-driven with context caveats.
